newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALIAN JULY CAR REGISTRATIONS ROSE 54.06 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ITALIAN JULY CAR REGISTRATIONS ROSE 54.06 PCT.

text.p: Italian new car registrations rose 54.06 percent to 246,500 units in July, compared with 160,007 in July 1996, the Ministry of Transport said.
Fiat group July new car registrations in Italy rose 57.13 percent to 108,970.
In the seven month period January-July 1997, ministry figures show that new car registrations in Italy rose 34.40 percent to 1,558,900 vehicles.
In this same period, Fiat group new registrations rose 32.6 percent to 676,651 compared to the 510.088 recorded in the same seven month period of 1996.
